title: build-inspector-imports-a-device-to-run-the-verdict-gate
author: CC
owner: codemother owns build_inspector and the verdict validator both; the move is Akien's call
intention: cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:58 reads `from cairn.devices.codemother.machines.verdict.verdict import claiming_packets, unanswered, verdict_error`. build_inspector is a top-level MACHINE (cairn/machines/build_inspector) and that line imports a DEVICE's nested machine, so the machine cannot be included by anyone who does not also carry codemother. The new machine_imports_no_device sieve (ticket 76639374d9f9) reds exactly this one line on its first live run over all 11 top-level machines; every other machine is clean, and skill_block's db_domain import is forgiven by enumeration as ruled. Put the verdict validator where a machine may reach it, or make the exit gate ask codemother for it over the bus, so the sieve reads clean without being narrowed.
why: Law 4 — the rule 'a machine imports no device' shipped as physics today and its first honest reading is red on the inspector itself; leaving the red standing with a paragraph beside it is the corrosion shape CLAUDE.md names. Law 6 — the validator moved under codemother when codemother took ownership of the care of the code (commit 7b99c8d), which is right; what did not move is the inspector's dependence on it, so a machine now reaches into a device's tree for a function the device owns. CLAUDE.md's rung ladder: a machine is tools plus glue; a device is its own process. The exit gate composing a device's internals by import is the rung ladder read backwards.
how: TWO DISPOSITIONS, and the choice is Akien's because it is an ownership question (Law 6), not a code one. (A) the verdict validator is a TOOL — it is tree-free (ast/json/pathlib), has no state of its own, and both the inspector and codemother's deposit face compose it; move it to cairn/tools/verdict/ with its proofs, leave codemother re-exporting it, and the import at inspector.py:58 becomes a tool import. (B) the validator stays codemother's and build_inspector asks for the verdict verdict over the bus (memory: inter-device-queries-via-bus-verbs) — heavier, and it puts a bus dial inside a gate that is today pure. Either way, DO NOT touch the sieve: no exemption, no prefix widening, no moving inspector.py under codemother to make the guard skip it. After the fix, re-run machine_imports_no_device over the live census and record zero findings in the verdict artifact.
falsifier: DONE when `machine_imports_no_device({'dir': 'machines/build_inspector', 'component': 'build_inspector'}, repo/cairn/machines/build_inspector)` returns [] on the live tree AND the sieve itself is byte-identical to what 76639374d9f9 sealed (git diff on the function is empty) AND test_inspector.py's verdict-gate teeth still pass. WRONG INTENT if the green comes from an exemption, a widened prefix, a relocated inspector, or a sieve that stopped looking.
